critic_dispositions.independent_judgment: Supported recipient/copy boundary clarification; current per-viewer checks already point in this direction. Useful precision, not independent evidence of deployed safety.
Supported representation-state refinement. Digest/extractor version already exists; format/locale and explicit ambiguity oracle improve the proposal without proving an edition mismatch.
Useful derived-data lifecycle/owner inventory. Future backups/queues deletion policy is not a fact available here; do not invent it or demand deployment.
Supported consequential alias action-success condition omitted by draft; atomic publication alone is insufficient to establish intended action-list success.
Supported explicit OR/mixed-role/override configuration detail; draft only calls it a caveat. Historical code/caller/tests independently corroborate the mechanism.
Supported tension: a historical-ACL-only owner choice can preserve withdrawn access. Other draft passages require current checks; no actual leak is demonstrated.

Invariant-first wording is useful, but draft step 3 already permits an owner-approved authorization service. A claim that it forces direct synchronous source calls would overstate the text. No new material topology defect established.

preservation.meaning: Retrieval/authority separation, current access checks, quote/position limits, version retention and no-export-revocation survive into available draft.
No adoption, rejection, repair or loss is fabricated.

limitations: Finite assessed planning quality, not universal correctness, exhaustive external discovery recall, deployment success or a reliability estimate.
No user source platform, corpus, authoritative policy status, embedding model/license, retention period or revocation consistency contract is selected; those facts legitimately remain unknown.
Public latest routes are mutable and unpinned; detailed deployed release/role/license qualification remains future owner work.
Upstream code and test sources were inspected; no downloaded code or proposed product/test harness was executed.
Private routing identity, raw native responses, token values, full transcripts and machine state are excluded from these scientific outputs.
Technique-bearing path names, declared topology and output make blinding imperfect.
Only exact allowlisted terminal snapshots/supplements/status/failure custody were read; active referenced originals and held-out cases were not followed.
No outcome after the truth-critic interruption is reconstructed. The unlaunched reviser and absent final remain in the assigned denominator.
